result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I changed one query in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (around line 6514):

- Added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the purchase order subquery, the same filter the per-quarter and latest-purchase-order reports use.
- Updated the Javadoc to say cancelled purchase orders are not counted.

Ordering, the zero-count reps, and the one-count-per-rep rule are unchanged. The project compiles offline, and `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes. That test has no cancelled-order case, so the new filter is not covered by a test. I didn't add one to keep the change small; say if you want one. Nothing is committed.
